stories.title: IndiGo Flight From Mangaluru Suffers Bird Strike At Navi Mumbai Airport, Aircraft Grounded For Inspection Amid FAA Safety Audit
stories.summary: Mumbai: An IndiGo flight from Mangaluru on Tuesday reported a bird strike on its arrival at the Navi Mumbai Airport on Tuesday, a source said. The bird hit the right side of the fuselage of the aircraft, which has now been grounded for inspection, the source said.

stories.title: 53 year old man stabbed in local train, accused arrested
stories.summary: An elderly passenger was allegedly stabbed inside a Virar-Churchgate fast local, leaving him injured near Andheri railway station. The incident took place on November 15, when train was heading to Churchgate, near Andheri station, the accused threw knife on fellow passenger, identified as Suresh Sharma (53), a resident of Dharavi’s Sion area.

stories.title: Prince William Presents 5 Earthshot Prize Winners With $1.3 Million Each
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales have said environmental innovators are changing the lives of future generations as they celebrated this year's winners of the Earthshot Prize. Five award-winners were named at a ceremony in Mumbai, India, and will each receive £1m to scale up their projects.

stories.title: Prince William, Princess Kate To Meet PM Modi In Delhi Today
stories.summary: Ever since Britain's royal couple landed in India, they have been serving one fantastic look after another, showcasing a range of styles, from casual and contemporary to sleek and formal. This time, they embraced desi-inspired attires, looking mesmerising and majestic. Prince William and Kate Middleton attended the Earthshot Prize 2026 in Mumbai, looking like they had stepped straight out of a desi fairytale in their regal ensembles.

stories.title: Missing three-year-old boy found dead in Andheri drain after three-day search
stories.summary: The body of a three-year-old boy, who had gone missing from the DN Nagar area on November 14, was found floating in a drain in Andheri West on Tuesday, bringing a tragic end to the search for the child. Preliminary investigations suggest that he may have accidentally fallen into the drain and drowned.

stories.title: Salman Khan surprises Maatrubhumi cast and crew with luxury watches worth up to ₹6 lakh at Panvel farmhouse
stories.summary: Salman Khan recently gave the cast and crew of his upcoming film Maatrubhumi : May War Rest in Peace a reason to remember their time on the project. The actor hosted a get-together at his Panvel farmhouse on November 12, where he surprised the team with luxury Swiss watches.

stories.title: After 15-year delay, BMC clears 27 structures for road widening in Kandivali
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Tuesday demolished 27 structures that had been obstructing a long-pending road-widening project at the Mathuradas Road-Swami Vivekanand Road junction in Kandivali West. The demolition drive was carried out by the civic body's R-South Ward under its 'Pedestrian First' campaign, which aims to make footpaths more accessible to pedestrians by removing encroachments and clearing roads.

stories.title: Subordinate court staff go on indefinite strike over pay parity
stories.summary: Around 34,000 subordinate court employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, demanding a revised pay scale on par with Bombay High Court staff. The strike disrupted work in courts across Mumbai, with hundreds of employees gathering outside the Sessions Court in Fort. The agitation has been called by four major associations representing subordinate court employees.

stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. BMC officials on Tuesday, November 17, announced that the birth certificates would be issued directly at the hospitals where the children are born.

stories.title: Mumbai Airport Chaos: Hundreds Of SpiceJet Passengers Stranded As No Flights Depart For Over 12 Hours - VIDEOS
stories.summary: Mumbai: Hundreds of passengers were left stranded at Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport after SpiceJet departures reportedly remained suspended for over 12 hours, with no clarity on revised flight schedules. Frustrated travellers gathered at the airline's counters, shouting slogans and demanding answers as videos of the commotion surfaced on social media.

stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested for demanding Rs 1 lakh from Nanded businessman
stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. stories.title: Man hit by knife thrown during fight on local train
stories.summary: A 53-year-old man was injured after a knife thrown during a fight between two passengers on a local train struck him in the chest on Sunday, the latest among several violent incidents this year that have drawn attention to commuter safety on the suburban rail network.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai: Six arrested for posing as FDA officials and extorting shop owners
stories.summary: A Toyota Innova Crysta with a Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) flag, fake Food and Drug Administration (FDA) identity cards and threats of raids and criminal cases — these were all used by a six-member gang that targeted pan shops selling gutkha in Navi Mumbai. stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested in Mumbai for threatening businessman with claims of plotting to kill ex-CM
stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. stories.title: Mumbai: BEST Bus Catches Fire Near Sassoon Dock; Video Shows Exact Moments When Blaze Erupts
stories.summary: Mumbai: A BEST bus caught fire near Sassoon Dock in South Mumbai on Wednesday morning after sparks were noticed near its starter, triggering smoke and flames. The incident occurred around 7 am while the bus was travelling from Colaba Depot towards Gita Nagar.

stories.title: HC tells BMC to take measures to prevent dog bites in Kandivali society
stories.summary: More than 50 dog bites in a year, and the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) caught two dogs and then released back where they were found: this is what residents of a Kandivali housing society told the Bombay High Court, which has now directed the civic body to take effective measures to stop the attacks and file an affidavit by December 1 detailing the steps taken.

stories.title: Mumbai Metro-5 gets first train at Kasheli Depot as preparations gather pace
stories.summary: The first train has entered the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority's (MMRDA's) Kasheli Depot, marking a milestone in preparations for Mumbai Metro Line-5. The arrival brings the depot’s role into focus: Kasheli will be the base where trains for the Thane–Bhiwandi–Kalyan corridor are parked, inspected, tested and maintained.

stories.title: BMC hospitals to issue birth certificates to newborns within three days; parents need not visit ward offices
stories.summary: The facility will be available at four major BMC hospitals and 16 suburban hospitals. The BMC had approached the state govt seeking authorisation for the deans and medical superintendents of its major and suburban hospitals to register births and deaths at their respective institutions.

stories.title: Mumbai Railway accident survivor gets second chance as doctors save severed foot
stories.summary: I will bounce back soon and start afresh.” These are the determined words of 30-year-old Ronak Bhuptani, a chartered accountant (CA) who survived a devastating railway accident that completely severed his left foot above the ankle. Though two hospitals initially ruled out reattachment, a surgical team at Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital successfully saved his limb through a complex microsurgical procedure.

stories.title: Mumbai birdwatchers raise alarm over alleged encroachment near Lokhandwala Lake
stories.summary: One of Mumbai's popular birdwatching destinations , Lokhandwala Lake, could be facing an ecological threat after a portion of its surrounding green patch was allegedly cleared and used for dumping mud and other material. A section of the barricading around the site appears to have been removed, exposing the land to what looks like unauthorised filling.

stories.title: Does a leopard sighting mean danger? Experts question trapping in Goregaon East
stories.summary: Does a leopard sighting automatically mean human-leopard conflict , or that the animal will attack people? Wildlife enthusiasts are raising these questions after the Mumbai Range of the Thane Forest Department (Territorial) installed a trap cage in Goregaon East near Nagari Niwara. stories.summary: 12-crore money laundering case linked to Torres Jewellery was brought to Mumbai from Romania on Tuesday after the Enforcement Directorate (ED) secured his extradition, news agency ANI reported. 45 pm. A three-member ED team brought him to India via the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

stories.summary: The Bandra West Residents' Association (BWRA) has flagged alleged neglect and poor maintenance of the popular Carter Road promenade . stories.summary: KEM Hospital began treatment of a 58-year-old homeless woman and took her for pre-surgery tests on Tuesday morning, after mid-day intervened over allegations that she had been left unattended for more than a day despite being brought to the civic-run hospital early on Sunday.

stories.title: Mumbai: Prince William takes electric rickshaw for a spin at Bandra reclamation
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, William and Catherine, drove an electric autorickshaw on the promenade at Bandra Reclamation Garden on Tuesday morning. The appearance was to meet the finalists of the Earthshot Prize at the waterfront. Tuesday marked the second day of their ongoing three-day visit to Mumbai.

stories.title: Anne Hathaway Welcomes Third Baby With Husband Adam Shulman, Beams With Joy As She Steps Out With Newborn In New York—PHOTOS
stories.summary: Actress Anne Hathaway has welcomed her third child with husband Adam Shulman, months after announcing her pregnancy in June 2026. The couple, who tied the knot in 2012, are already parents to two sons, born in 2016 and 2019.

stories.title: Two Indian crew members injured, one missing after missile attack on LPG tanker in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Two Indian crew members sustained injuries and another went missing after Panama-flagged LPG tanker MT Tara Gas was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, ministry of external affairs said. A report by the directorate of maritime administration said that the Tara Gas vessel was subjected to two separate external attacks on November 17 while navigating the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Amazon commits fresh $7 billion in India for green energy
stories.summary: According to industry estimates, more than 5GW of data centre capacity is currently in the pipeline in India. While the country's existing capacity is less than 2GW, govt estimates it could rise to 24-26GW over the next five years. Amazon also announced four new utility-scale wind and solar projects with a combined capacity of 934MW, which are part of its existing $4 billion portfolio of contracted projects in India.

stories.title: GRAP-3 lifted as Delhi air improves, but Gurugram AQI worsens | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Gurugram’s air quality deteriorated on Tuesday, with the air quality index (AQI) rising 43 points to 290, even as the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) revoked Stage 3 restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) across Delhi-NCR following an improvement in Delhi’s pollution levels. Delhi recorded an AQI of 204, also in the ‘poor’ category, while one of Gurugram’s four monitoring stations registered ‘very poor’ air quality.

stories.title: Nasa’s Voyager 1 to reach one light-day from Earth today; why it's important
stories.summary: Nearly 50 years after it began its journey from Earth, Nasa's Voyager 1 spacecraft is set to cross a milestone that no other human-made object has reached. The milestone is known as one light-day. According to Nasa, Voyager 1 is expected to reach the one-light-day mark at 5:16:07 am EST on Wednesday.

stories.title: Indian Army To Restore Regimental Identity In Senior Officers' Uniforms From December 1; Trademark Hats, Maroon Berets To Return
stories.summary: The Indian Army has decided to bring back regimental and corps-specific distinctions in the uniforms of senior officers, reversing a dress code introduced in 2023 that required Brigadiers and officers of higher ranks to follow a common uniform. The revised directive will come into effect from December 1, 2026, restoring distinctive berets, shoulder titles, lanyards and belts associated with different regiments and services.

stories.title: Calcutta HC issues show-cause notice to Abhishek Banerjee for his alleged remarks against judges
stories.summary: The Calcutta high court on Tuesday issued a show-cause notice against Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (MAITC) MP Abhishek Banerjee, directing him to show cause why appropriate punishments shouldn’t be imposed for his alleged remarks against high court judges. This comes days after Banerjee attacked the judiciary for dilly-dallying over a case related to his security downgrade following the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government coming to power.

stories.title: LeT Commander Lateef Bhat Cornered In J&K's Kulgam; Police Ask Him To Surrender During Video Call As Fresh Encounter Breaks Out - Watch
stories.summary: A fresh encounter broke out between security forces and terrorists in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kulgam district on Wednesday as the search for Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) commander Lateef Bhat intensified.

stories.title: Char Dham Yatra sees 29% rise in pilgrims, 63% jump in fatalities in 2026
stories.summary: 65 lakh pilgrims visited the Char Dham shrines and Hemkund Sahib in 2026, a 29 per cent increase over the previous year, even as pilgrim fatalities rose by 63 per cent, according to a Dehradun-based non-profit organisation. A total of 65,65,197 pilgrims visited the five shrines this year, compared to 51,07,346 in 2025, an increase of 14,57,851, the analysis by social and environmental non-profit SDC Foundation showed.

stories.title: Hopkins man Samit Patel charged with attempted murder, carjacking after brutal attack on Uber driver | Trending
stories.summary: A 25-year-old Hopkins man has been charged in the brutal attack on an Uber driver that left him critically injured. Samit Apurva Patel was charged with attempted second-degree murder and first-degree carjacking, according to a criminal complaint filed Tuesday in Hennepin County District Court. According to a CBS News report, the criminal complaint states that the Uber driver, Mohamed Yusuf, has a poor prognosis.

stories.title: How India became a rice powerhouse - and why it's becoming a problem
stories.summary: "In effect, we are using taxpayers' money to subsidise foreign consumers," said Ashok Gulati, an agricultural economist and former government adviser on crop prices. The rise has been supported by a federal rice subsidy system since the mid-1960s, when India struggled to feed itself.

stories.title: Lateef Bhat, last active terrorist commander in South Kashmir, killed in Kulgam encounter: Officials
stories.summary: Mohammed Lateef Bhat, the most wanted local terrorist in Jammu and Kashmir and believed to be the last active local commander in South Kashmir, was killed in an encounter with security forces in Kulgam district on Wednesday, officials said, ending a year-long hunt for him. Bhat, 23, had been trapped inside a mosque in Zangalgam village since Wednesday morning, after security forces launched an operation to track him down.

stories.title: Alleged arms supplier Wahid Ansari killed in police encounter in Uttar Pradesh's Ambedkar Nagar
stories.summary: Alleged arms supplier Wahid Ansari was killed in a police encounter in Uttar Pradesh's Ambedkar Nagar late on Tuesday night. Police described 35-year-old Ansari as a major supplier of illegal firearms in eastern Uttar Pradesh, who was allegedly involved in several contract killings.

stories.title: SpiceJet passenger lands in Delhi with ₹94 lakh Patek Philippe watch, arrested | Trending
stories.summary: Delhi Customs has arrested a passenger who landed in the national capital with a “pre-owned” luxury wristwatch valued at ₹ 94 lakh. Customs officials at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport seized the Patek Philippe watch from the passenger on November 11. The arrest and the seizure was announced in a social media post by Delhi Customs yesterday.

stories.summary: 5 crore to three districts for advance preparedness and evacuation, landslide mapping and tourist curbs, officials said. stories.title: Elephant dies after coming in contact with a high-tension wire hanging loose in Jharkhand
stories.summary: An elephant dies after coming in contact with a live wire hanging loose above a paddy field in Jharkhand's Seraikela-Kharswan district, officials said on Tuesday. An elephant has been electrocuted after it came in contact with a high-tension wire hanging loose above a paddy field in Jharkhand's Seraikela-Kharswan district, officials said on Tuesday.

stories.title: LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat escaped operation that killed aide; third getaway in a year: Officials
stories.summary: Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorist Lateef Bhat is confirmed to have escaped a security operation that killed his aide in south Kashmir’s Kulgam, making it the third time the 23-year-old has slipped away in the past year, people aware of the matter said on Tuesday. stories.summary: The shoot of Maddock Films ' upcoming film, Mission Mirchi, was hit by tragedy on Tuesday after a technician working on the production died in a road accident. The film is being shot in Sikkim . Local police said that the 46-year-old technician died after a truck carrying shooting equipment met with an accident.

stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) called for “peace, stability, and predictability” in the world as he attended the ASEAN-India Summit, the East Asia Summit, and the Quad Leaders’ Summit in Manila, Philippines. stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales returned to India nearly a decade after their previous visit in 2016. stories.title: Whistleblower: Deadly drone strike in Kuwait could’ve been avoided
stories.summary: Washington, DC – An American soldier wounded in a deadly Iranian drone attack in Kuwait is accusing senior military officials of ignoring warnings and being ill-equipped ahead of launching the US-Israel war on Iran, according to a whistleblower complaint. stories.title: Indian national missing after attacks on commercial vessel in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: An Indian national went missing and two others sustained injuries after their Panama-flagged vessel came under attack in the Strait of Hormuz this week that triggered a strong condemnation from New Delhi. stories.summary: Karan Johar has given Bollywood several memorable on-screen pairs, and Kareena Kapoor and Hrithik Roshan's jodi from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (K3G) is certainly one of them.
